text.p: Novartis Seeds AG said Tuesday it is combining its four seed companies in the United States into one company, Novartis Seeds Inc.
Novartis Seeds is comprised of the field crops, flowers, vegetables and sugarbeet operations in the United States, Canada and Mexico.
"Creating a single legal entity will allow Novartis Seeds to make the most of synergies resulting from the Novartis merger," said Edward Shonsey, chief executive of the new company.
Initially, the combined company will be based in Golden Valley and will share finance, human resources and legal activities, Novartis Seeds said in a news release.

Novartis Seeds is an affiliate of Novartis Seeds AG located in Switzerland. It develops genetics and value-added products, and produces and sells corn, soybean, alfalfa, sunflowers, sorghum, sugarbeet, wheat, vegetable and flower seeds.
